tool_limitations.limitation: Table enumerates ApplicationView/UIViewSettings/DisplayInformation/CoreApplication/SystemNavigationManager but omits SystemMediaTransportControls.GetForCurrentView(), the exact API in this app. Agent had no concrete replacement to copy.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP source uses it to listen for SoundLevel/media property changes.
failed_apis.root_cause: GetForCurrentView() throws at runtime in WinUI 3 desktop (no per-view singleton); skill's getforcurrentview table had no row for it, so agent wrapped the call in try/catch and set _systemMediaControls = null on failure — silently disabling the feature instead of using the HWND interop replacement.

doc_errors.wrong: WUI0004 symptom labeled 'SystemNavigationManager.GetForCurrentView() is UWP-only' with vague fix 'Drop the system back button hookup, or use HWND-based COM interop'.
doc_errors.correct: WUI0004 fires for multiple view-scoped UWP singletons including SystemMediaTransportControls.GetForCurrentView() (see actual build-output warning). Fix must name the concrete interop replacement, not just SystemNavigationManager.

special_apis.special_handling: In WinUI 3 desktop it is window-scoped: obtain via ISystemMediaTransportControlsInterop.GetForWindow(hwnd), not GetForCurrentView(). A try/catch that nulls it compiles and 'runs' but leaves the feature dead.
